title: I built Infinite Craft but for stickers
author: jdshop
selftext:
Hi all!

**Sticker Craft Infinite.**

Similar to Infinite Craft, you start with a few basic stickers, combine two at a time, and discover whatever weird new sticker comes out.

I’m hoping to get feedback on the game, so you will get free tokens to use early on to try a bunch of crafts. There’s also a feedback form in the app, and completing it gives **extra tokens** to craft with.

I’d love to hear from you on mechanics, content quality, and whether the game actually feels fun. Happy to answer questions about the tech side of things too. I made this as a personal project and just want to share with people that would enjoy it. Thanks!

**Link:**  [**https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761332426**](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761332426) 

Note: It’s iOS only for now in the  US, Canada, EU, and some other regions. Google Play public testing isn’t ready yet, I’ll follow up once that is done.
